quest.title: Business in a Marsh
quest.description: Huai'an can't stop worrying about the roaming monsters near Wangshu Inn...

dialogues.speaker: Huai'an
dialogues.text: This is becoming an absolute nightmare...

dialogues.speaker: Huai'an
dialogues.text: I haven't slept properly in days... See the dark circles under my eyes?

dialogues.speaker: Huai'an
dialogues.text: Have you met any of the guests? They're a handful, to say the least. A brand-new crisis with each one. One of them actually jumped from the top of the building. A building this high. What were they thinking!?

dialogues.speaker: Huai'an
dialogues.text: But never mind that. Right now, I'm waiting on a food delivery from the city, it should be here soon.

dialogues.speaker: Huai'an
dialogues.text: There are monsters on the road though, and they're sure to stir up trouble. Could I trouble you to get rid of them for me?

choices.text: It's like this place is cursed...

response.speaker: Huai'an
response.text: Well... When your doors are open to travelers from all over the world, expect a world's worth of baggage... That's what I like to say.

response.speaker: Huai'an
response.text: We can manage though. It's just an inn that's a bit further out and a bit busier than most.

response.speaker: Huai'an
response.text: I appreciate your help. Thanks, and good luck.

dialogues.speaker: Huai'an
dialogues.text: How's it coming along? All clear?

dialogues.speaker: Huai'an
dialogues.text: Okay, please be as quick as you can. The chef has run out of supplies.

dialogues.speaker: Huai'an
dialogues.text: I could go and sort it myself if it came to it, but that's a last resort.

dialogues.speaker: Huai'an
dialogues.text: How's it coming along? All clear?

dialogues.speaker: Huai'an
dialogues.text: Here's your payment. If you're ever in the area again, feel free to stop by anytime.
